title: Guardian Gate: compact audit timeline + on-call rollback microflows
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact, scannable audit timeline called Guardian Gate that sits in workspace and org settings. It surfaces temporal grants, truncated diffs, and one-click rollback / emergency revoke microflows for on-call operators. Includes cost context for provisioning, pre-populated playbook copy, and a minimal footprint UI for nav-constrained consoles (compact list + expandable detail). Goal is to reduce mean-time-to-resolve for permission incidents while preserving least-privilege workflows and auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Compact timeline displays most recent 50 audit events and paginates beyond that
Each event shows actor, delta summary (added/removed roles/permissions), timestamp, and optional cost delta when provisioning a dedicated feature
One-click emergency revoke and timebound rollback action flows are accessible from each event with clear confirmation steps and audit annotations
Prototype validated in two Guerrilla usability sessions (internal infra and security reps) with at least 80% task completion for 'revoke a mis-granted role' scenario
Design handoff artifacts include annotated Figma screens, interaction spec, and list of telemetry events required by engineering
tasks: Finalize compact list and expanded detail visual language
Annotate prototype with event schema and telemetry requirements
Collaborate with Eng to define backend query limits and pagination contract

Run 2 internal usability sessions and capture video + synthesize feedback
comments: 2025-09-04 Maya Patel: Initial kickoff review with PM and SRE. Agreed to include cost delta on provisioning events only (not for permission-only changes).

2025-09-06 Diego Ramirez (Eng): Feasibility spike shows we can attach a delta cost estimate for Dedicated capacity events if we memoize last-known pricing; need a backend ticket for pricing cache (ENG-21219).
2025-09-08 Priya Kapoor (PM): Suggest adding 'escalation path' metadata to events so on-call sees recommended approver chain in the revoke flow.
2025-09-10 Lena Cho: Prototype v1 uploaded, focusing on compact rows + expand. Noted accessibility issues with color contrast on tags — will update.

2025-09-12 Omar Singh (Security): Request to preserve immutable audit_reason string and surface it at top of revoke flow. Also flagged need for security review if we enable direct rollback (see decisions).
2025-09-14 Design review: PM + Eng + Security accepted flow with minor copy edits. Engineering requested a sample schema for timebound grants (start/end + delegate id).
decisions: Show cost delta only for events that create Dedicated or private resource provisioning to avoid noise on pure permission changes.
Emergency revoke will be available to users with 'oncall_revoke' capability; general rollback requires multi-approver flow to prevent abuse.
Compact timeline will default to reverse-chronological 50-row preview with 'Load older' pagination; deep queries handled in Audit Explorer (separate product ticket).
Prototype uses summarization heuristics: group sequential grants by the same actor within 2 minutes into a single collapsed row to reduce chaff.
tradeoffs: Surface-level summarization reduces noise but can obscure fine-grained diffs needed for forensic analysis — mitigated via expand into full diff and link to raw event JSON
One-click revokes speed incident response but increase blast risk — mitigated via capability gating and post-action immutable audit_reason prompt
Cost context improves decision-making but requires an eventual pricing cache and approximation; initially we'll show 'estimated' badge and link to official billing view
